prompt:
Using the radical prostatectomy (RP) report, please extract several pieces of information: 1) the gleason score (e.g. 3+4), 2) the pathologic tumor stage (e.g. T3a), 3) the percentage of prostate tissue involved (e.g. 11-20%), 4) the number of lymph nodes involved with prostate cancer, 5) the total number of lymph nodes examined, and 6) the surgical margin status (positive or negative). These should be reported, in order, in this compact JSON format: {{"gs": "[gleason score]", "tstage": "[pathologic T stage]", "pct": "[percent of prostate involved]", "n_pos": "[number lymph nodes involved]", "n_tot": "[number total lymph nodes examined], "margin": "[surgical margin, positive or negative]"}}. Use the following rules in your analysis:
- For gleason score (first field), report in (primary+secondary) format, like "3+4, "3+3", etc. If no adenocarcinoma is present, or the gleason score is not given, report "N/A".
- For the second field (pathologic T stage), report the T stage as given in the report (e.g. T2c, T3b, T2, etc). If T stage is not given, use these rules, reporting the highest T stage: if there is bladder, rectum, muscles, or pelvic wall, report T4. If there is seminal vesicle invasion, report T3b. If there is extracapsular extension, report T3a. If there is no organ invasion, seminal vesicle invasion, or extracapsular extension, report pT2.
- For the third field (percent prostate involved), report the percentage as written in the report (e.g. 50%). If a range is given, report the range (e.g. 11-20%). If not reported, report "N/A".
- For the fourth field (number LNs positive), report the total number of involved lymph nodes given in the report. If the pathologic nodal stage (pN stage) is given as pN0, you can assume 0 LNs involved. If no LNs were taken, or the number positive was not reported, report "N/A".
- For the fifth field (number LNs examined), report the total number of LNs examined; if no LNs were taken, or if this number is not reported, report "N/A".\n\r-For the sixth field (surgical margins), report this as "positive" if any margins were involved, and "negative" if margins were clear. Tumor that approaches the margin, but does not involve it, should be reported as negative.
- If the pathology report is not from a prostatectomy, or prostate adenocarcinoma is not present in the specimen, report "N/A" for all fields.
{input}
